prompt: Use case precise-object-edit. Redesign first attached rejected barley strip to unmistakable RIPE BARLEY, using second attached WHEAT strip ONLY as negative shape comparison and palette reference. The output MUST NOT resemble wheat tufts, fern plumes, braided arch rows, mirrored V leaves, scalloped waves or a row of fountains. Dramatically reduce density: ONE irregular row of just 9-11 separate heads across the full strip, with exposed brown soil gaps. Each head is a DISTINCT elongated narrow capsule, hanging nearly VERTICALLY DOWNWARD from a sharply bent slender inverted-J stem. A long bristly BEARD extends beyond the lower tip of each capsule to about ONE WHOLE EXTRA HEAD LENGTH, grouped into 3-5 broad pale strands so the hanging beard silhouette survives thumbnail scale. Heads narrow and long like hanging paintbrushes, NOT broad feather fans; keep empty air between hanging head and its stem. Some lean left, some right, different stem heights, no regular arches, no paired fans, no horizontal repetitive chevron. Mature BARLEY long awns, pendulous heads. Target512x64, entire active band48px tall plus8px transparent top andbottom margins; heads plus beards28-36px long, spaced35-60px apart. XONLY seamless continuous warmsoil fullwidth without Xpadding, organic Yalpha fade. Low-saturation pale cream straw heads and mutedolive stalks, soft evenlight no shadows. Broad painterly citybuilder style, true transparentRGBA, no finegrain noise, labels, text, people, hops or background square. Preserve strip role and exact targetdimensions but entirely replace crop morphology.
